name: Full-width bar, even link pitch
description: A full-width bar 60px tall, filled in the surface tone (one step from the ground) from the first pixel and fixed. A small monogram or wordmark at the left margin (h4 step); four one-word links at 16px whose centres sit on an even 250px pitch across the middle of the screen (x about 345, 595, 845 and 1095 at 1440), so no link is nearer another than 120px of air; at the right margin one text link and a small action pill 36px tall in the accent. Ink is dark on a light surface tone (light on a dark page). Hover: the hovered link takes the accent while the others keep their ink, no underline. On a phone: a 56px bar with the wordmark left and a Menu text button and the action right.
phone: 56px bar: wordmark left, Menu and the action right.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the translucent blurred bar is an opaque surface-tone bar; the idea, links on a wide even pitch, stays and only the see-through effect is lost on purpose. Un-banned.

name: Bottom-docked pill groups
description: Docked at the bottom instead of the top. Two opaque pill groups 45px tall float 20px above the bottom edge and 38px in from the sides, in the surface tone with ink letters (the page ground showing round them): at the left one pill that names the section in view (one or two words that change as scroll passes the sections); at the right a pill of two one-word links followed by the one action as a filled accent pill. Both slide down out of view on scroll down (translateY 140%, 280ms) and come back on the first scroll up. At the top of the first screen only the wordmark stands, at the left margin, in flow, scrolling away with the hero. The page keeps 96px free under its last line. On a phone: one full-width opaque bar, 56px plus the safe area, 10px in from the sides, holding Menu, the section name and the action.
phone: One full-width opaque dock 56px plus the safe area: Menu, section name, the action.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the translucent glass pills are opaque surface-tone pills; the idea, bottom-docked groups that hide on scroll down, stays. The left pill shows a one- or two-word section name only. Un-banned.

name: Centred wordmark with right-hand controls
description: No bar: the wordmark (or a compact emblem lockup) centred at the top, its centre 40px below the top edge, at the h3 step, on a small solid tab of the page ground. At the right margin a Menu text button and the one action as an accent pill; if the page really has sound or a second language, a one-word toggle (Sound, EN) before Menu. The left stays empty by design: the centred wordmark is the only anchor, so the pair of right-hand items must be at least 160px wide in all. Unchanged on scroll. Menu opens the links in a full-screen sheet on the ink. On a phone: wordmark centred, Menu at the right, the action at the foot of the sheet.
phone: Wordmark centred, Menu at the right, the action in the sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after changes: the right side always carries Menu or the action so a real navigation exists; the sound toggle and language link are kept only if the page has audio or a second language.

name: Centred wordmark-and-links cluster
description: One tight group centred on a 56px solid band of the page ground: a small wordmark (h4 step, in the ink) followed 40px later by three one-word links at 16px, 28px apart, the last of them the one action in the accent at weight 600. The group is about 460px wide at 1440 and sits exactly on the centre line; the left and right slots stay empty, so the bar reads as a pause in the page. Fixed and identical at every scroll position; over a hero of the same ground the band is invisible. Hover: the hovered item takes the accent. On a phone: the cluster shrinks to the wordmark and a Menu text button centred together, and a tap opens the full-screen sheet with the action at its foot.
phone: Wordmark and Menu centred together; sheet carries the action.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after changes: the fill-less layer becomes a solid band so content never runs under letters; three links only, one being the action.

name: Compact panel, top right
description: A compact opaque panel fixed at the top right, aligned to the right page margin and 20px below the top edge, about 580px wide and 56px tall, filled with the surface tone with the dealt panel corner. The wordmark chip at the left (h4 step), three to five one-word links at 15-16px, and the one action as a filled button 40px tall at the right end. The action's fill follows the ground of the section in view: the accent on light sections, the ink on dark ones, never another hue. The top left of the screen stays free for the hero's headline or picture. Hover: the link letters take the accent. On a phone: the panel spans the margins at 56px holding the wordmark and Menu; the action sits in the sheet.
phone: Panel spans the margins at 56px: wordmark and Menu; the action in the sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: glass replaced by an opaque surface-tone panel; the scene-tinted action fill is limited to accent or ink so there is no colour sprawl. Un-banned.

name: Corner clusters of angular buttons
description: A fixed band 90px tall on the page ground in two clusters. Left: a 64px mark (the first letter of the name in the dealt type, or the client's real mark) followed by one small angular action button. Right: four angular link buttons in a row. Angular means a rectangle with two opposite corners cut at 45 degrees by 10px (clip-path), 40px tall, 16px text, 12px gaps; the action is filled in the accent and the four links in the surface tone with ink letters, never outlined. Unchanged on scroll. Hover: the button's fill steps to the ink and its letters to the ground (160ms). On a phone: the mark, the action button and a Menu button in one 64px row; Menu opens a full-screen sheet with the four links as large angular buttons stacked.
phone: 64px row: mark, action button, Menu; sheet of stacked angular buttons.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The cut corners are a button shape, not a drawn illustration; buttons are filled not outlined; the mark is typeset or the client's own, not a drawn character; the fill-less band is a solid ground band.

name: Corner HUD with centre toggle and menu pill
description: A fixed layer for a one-screen or pinned-stage page whose canvas does not scroll, five items 32px from the screen edges. Top left a 64px monogram chip (the first letter or the client's mark, ink fill with ground letters). Top centre a two-option segmented control 44px tall and about 220px wide in the surface tone, the current option filled in the ink; two one-word options that switch the stage between two real modes of the page. Top right a Menu pill 44px tall filled in the accent. Bottom left a Sound toggle (only if the page has audio); bottom right a 160x96 still of the film, opening it. Hover: the segmented fill slides to the other option (240ms). On a phone the three top items stay 16px in; the sound toggle and the still sit in one row above the safe area; Menu opens a full-screen sheet.
phone: Three top items 16px in; sound and film still in a row above the safe area.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after changes: the mascot becomes a typeset monogram (no drawn character); the toggle is a filled segmented control; the sound button only if the page has audio; used only on a one-screen page so the layer never sits on scrolling content.

name: Corner wordmark shrinks, link pill hides on scroll down
description: No bar fill. At the top-left margin a wordmark about 200px wide (h3 step) that, over the first 720px of scroll, scales down and crossfades into a 52px monogram chip (ink fill, ground letter), solid by the time content arrives. At the right a capsule 52px tall in the surface tone holding four one-word links at 15-16px, which slides up out of view on scroll down (translateY -140%, 280ms) and returns on the first scroll up; beside it, at the right margin, the one action as an accent pill that always stays. Everything that stays fixed stands on a solid fill, so nothing bare runs over content. Hover: the link letters roll. On a phone: the wordmark (shrinking to the chip) at the left and a Menu text button at the right; the action sits in the sheet's foot and as a pill after the hero.
phone: Wordmark shrinks to the chip at the left; Menu at the right; the action as a pill after the hero.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The mascot-style mark is a typeset monogram; the capsule and pill are opaque; the fading lockup is a solid chip once content is under it.

name: Corner wordmark becomes a monogram, links fold into a trigger
description: No bar: the wordmark at the top-left margin (h3 step) and four one-word links at the top right with the one action as an accent pill at the right margin. After 80px of scroll the wordmark swaps for a 48px monogram chip (ink fill, ground letter) by a crossfade with a 6px upward slide (240ms), and the four links collapse into one 48px Menu pill beside the action. The action stays visible throughout. Menu opens the links in a full-screen sheet. Ink and chip fills flip between the page's ink and ground to stay readable over the sections. Hover: the Menu pill's fill swaps ground to ink. On a phone: the chip and the Menu pill from the start, 16px in, with the action in the sheet's foot.
phone: Wordmark or chip at the left, Menu pill at the right from the start.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The mascot mark is replaced by a typeset monogram; the fixed chip and pill are solid; the action stays outside the trigger so it remains in reach.

name: Strip of four equal tone cells
description: A fixed strip 44px tall, full width, cut into four equal 360px cells at 1440. Cell one holds the wordmark (h4 step), cells two and three one-word links at 16px, cell four the one action. Each cell has its text 32px in from its left edge and is a flat fill from the page's own palette only (ground, surface tone, ink and accent, never four new hues); the action cell is the accent. The strip is solid and fixed and does not change on scroll. Hover: the hovered cell's fill swaps to the ink and its letters to the ground (160ms). On a phone: the strip becomes a 56px bar with the wordmark and Menu; the sheet opens as four equal full-height blocks stacked, each one a link or the action, filling the screen.
phone: 56px bar with wordmark and Menu; the sheet is four equal full-height blocks.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after changes: four different colours would be colour sprawl, so the cells use only ground, surface, ink and accent tones; cell one holds the wordmark so it is a real navigation; 27px raised to 44px so text is readable.

name: Floating box: mark, centred wordmark, Menu
description: A floating solid box 60px tall, inset to the page margins (about 1376px wide at 1440) and 20px below the top edge, filled with the page ground (white on a light page) and kept solid over video or pictures, with the dealt corner radius, no border and no shadow. A 36px monogram chip at the left, the wordmark dead centre (h4 step), the Menu text button at the right in the accent; no links in the bar. On scroll down the box slides 100px up out of view (280ms); on scroll up it returns. The links and the action live in the Menu's full-screen sheet on the ink. Hover on Menu: the fill swaps to the ink. On a phone: the same box 12px in and 52px tall, wordmark at the left, Menu at the right.
phone: 52px box 12px in: wordmark left, Menu right.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 1px light border is dropped (the solid box against the picture needs none); no shadow at rest. Over a full-bleed picture it reads as a header band, so keep it to one row. Un-banned.

name: Floating dark strip
description: A solid ink strip 64px tall floating 12px below the top edge and the page margin (about 32px) in from the sides, the dealt corner radius, no border, no shadow. The wordmark at the left (h4 step, ground-coloured); four or five one-word links centred at 16px, 32px apart; the one action at the right as a ground-coloured button with ink letters. Fixed and identical when scrolling in both directions. Hover: the hovered link's letters take the accent. On a phone: a 56px strip 12px in from the sides with the wordmark and Menu; Menu opens a full-screen sheet on the ink.
phone: 56px strip 12px in: wordmark and Menu.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Links capped at five; the strip is solid with no border and no shadow; over a photographic hero it reads as a header band, so keep it to one row.

name: Four-corner tab HUD
description: No bar: four small solid tabs pinned at the corners of the screen, each 32px in from its two edges and filled with the page ground (10-14px padding, the dealt corner). Top left the wordmark at the h4 step; top right a Menu text button at 16px; bottom left the one action as an accent tab with a two- or three-word label; bottom right one short utility word (Top or Sound) that fades in only after a screen of scroll. The tabs are fixed and never change, so no letters run over content; on a stage page whose canvas does not scroll the tabs may drop their fill and take one ink that reads on the stage. Menu opens a full-screen sheet on the ink: the section names stacked at the h2 step on the left, the action and the email on the right. Hover: a tab's fill swaps from the ground to the ink and its letters the other way (180ms). On a phone the two top tabs stay at 16px in; the action tab sits 16px above the bottom edge plus the safe area; the bottom-right item is dropped.
phone: Top-left wordmark tab and top-right Menu tab at 16px in; the action tab bottom left above the safe area; bottom-right item dropped.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Each corner item stands on a solid tab of the ground, so no bare letters run over content; items are one to three words in sentence case at 15-16px, no tiny uppercase captions, no partner line.

name: Centre panel with loose ends
description: Three loose pieces at the top of the first screen. At the left margin the wordmark (h4 step). In the centre an opaque panel 60px tall in the surface tone, the dealt corner, holding three one-word links and a filled accent button. At the right margin a search text link (only if the site has search) or one more text link. Over the hero the ends are bare letters on the page ground whose ink is chosen to read on the hero; once the hero has gone the ends fade out (200ms) and only the centre panel stays fixed, now with a 28px monogram at its left end, so nothing bare runs over content. Hover: link letters take the accent. On a phone: a single opaque 56px bar with the wordmark and Menu; the panel dissolves into the sheet.
phone: Single 56px opaque bar with wordmark and Menu.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the blurred panel is opaque; the mono status line (a sentence in mono) and the swatch chip are gone; type is proportional; the loose ends fade after the hero. Un-banned.

name: Full-width wordmark band, links along the foot
description: No bar and no trigger on the first screen. A wordmark band spans the full content width at the top of the screen (about 1376px wide at 1440, the name set on one line and scaled to the margins, 190-210px tall for a six- to eight-letter name). Along the bottom edge of the same screen, 40px above it, a single row: three or four one-word links at 16px in the ink at the left margin and the one action as a filled pill in the accent at the right margin, on the hero's own ground. Under the wordmark one sentence of at most 12 words says what the page is, at statement size, so the first screen has a clear title. The row scrolls away with the hero; after it a 56px solid band with the small wordmark and the action returns on scroll up. On a phone: the wordmark spans 350px (about 53px tall), the links drop to Menu at the bottom row beside the action.
phone: Wordmark across 350px; Menu and the action in the bottom row; band returns on scroll up.
houseRuleCheck: Clean with conditions. A giant name is banned in footers, not here, but the first screen still needs a clear title (the sentence under it); the bottom links are plain navigation, not a credit wall; the return band keeps the action in reach.

name: Large centred wordmark that shrinks into a band
description: No bar at first: a large wordmark centred at the top of the first screen, about 400px wide at 1440 (28% of the width, the name on one line), with one text link pinned at the left margin and the one action at the right margin (an accent text link at weight 600), both at 16px and aligned to the wordmark's baseline. Over the first 240px of scroll the wordmark scales to about 30% (120px wide, transform with its origin at top centre) while the two links stay where they are, and the row settles into a 64px solid band of the page ground, fixed from then on. The ink is one strong colour chosen to read on the hero and on the band. Needs a short name (up to about ten letters) that still holds at 120px. On a phone: the wordmark centred at 200px with Menu at the left and the action at the right, settling to a 56px band the same way.
phone: Wordmark centred at 200px, Menu left, action right; settles into a 56px band on scroll.
houseRuleCheck: Clean with a condition. A large wordmark in the bar is not the banned giant name (that ban is for footers), but it is dealt only where the hero headline is not the name; the blend-difference ink is replaced by one flat ink and the settled band is opaque.

name: Grid-column text clusters
description: A fixed band 88px tall on the page ground carrying four clusters aligned to the 12-column grid at 1440. Grid column 1 (x 40): the wordmark (h4 step). Column 4 (x about 386): a two-option text toggle, the two words side by side, the current one in the ink at weight 600 and the other in the muted ink, which switches the page's mode or language; on a page with no second mode or language, a note of one to three words in the muted ink (a place, a season, open or closed) stands there instead. Column 10 (x about 1080): a stack of three one-word links at 16px on a 26px line pitch. Column 12 (x about 1310): the one action as a text link at weight 600 in the accent. Unchanged between slides or sections. Hover: a link takes the accent (160ms). On a phone: the wordmark left and a Menu text button right; the toggle or note moves into the sheet.
phone: Wordmark left, Menu text button right; the toggle or note and the links in the full-screen sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after changes: the 12px line pitch (tiny text) becomes 15-16px type on a 26px pitch; the fill-less layer is a solid band wherever content can pass under it.

name: Grid-placed chip HUD, top and bottom
description: A fixed top strip 36px chips on the 12-column grid, 24px below the top edge: a monogram chip at column 1 (ink fill, ground letter), the wordmark chip at column 3 (surface tone, h4 step), three one-word link chips from column 5 (surface tone, 16px, 12px apart), and the one action chip at column 11 (accent). A second fixed strip 24px above the viewport floor holds two word chips (Top and Contact) at columns 1 and 2 and one wide chip about 280px across at columns 5 to 7 that names the section in view in one or two words. All chips are flat fills with 15-16px letters and the dealt corner. Hover: a chip's fill swaps to the ink. On a phone: the top row keeps the monogram, wordmark chip and Menu chip; the bottom strip keeps only the wide section chip.
phone: Top row: monogram, wordmark chip, Menu chip; bottom: the section chip only.
houseRuleCheck: Clean after changes: 22px chips would carry tiny text, so the chips are 36px with 15-16px letters; the icon chips are word chips; one accent chip only; a page made only of boxes is avoided by keeping chips to the two strips.

name: Large wordmark hands over to a corner mark
description: No bar: a large wordmark centred at the top of the hero, 320-480px wide at 1440 and 40px below the top edge, with nothing beside it. Over the first 120px of scroll it rises 24px and fades out while a small copy of the wordmark (h4 step) fades in at the top-left margin on a solid tab of the page ground (12px padding, the dealt corner). The right side holds a Menu text button and the one action, each on a tab of its own at the right margin (the action tab in the accent), fixed from the first pixel and never changing. The tabs stay fixed for the whole page, so nothing bare runs over content. Needs a hero whose headline is not the name. Hover: the tab fill swaps to the ink (180ms). On a phone: the large wordmark is 60% of the width and hands over to the small one the same way; Menu and the action stay at the right.
phone: Large wordmark at 60% width hands over to a small tab at the left; Menu and the action tabs at the right.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No dot rail beside the menu (a rail or progress device); the fixed items stand on solid tabs; the large wordmark is dealt only where the headline says something other than the name.

name: Top row with a bottom dial menu
description: A fixed layer that fades in after the intro. Top: the wordmark centred at the h3 step and the one action as an accent pill at the right margin, both on solid tabs of the ground. The menu is a dial fixed at the bottom of the screen: a filled disc in the surface tone, 1100px across, centred with its centre 454px below the bottom edge so only a 96px arc shows (620px wide where it meets the edge). Five one- or two-word section names sit on the rim, 13 degrees apart, in sentence case, the current one at the top of the arc in the ink at weight 600 and 17px, the others in the muted ink at 15px and turned with the rim. A tap or an arrow key on a neighbour, or the wheel over the dial, turns the names (320ms) and scrolls to that section. No rings, ticks or lines. The disc is opaque and the page keeps 120px free under its last line, so no text ends under the arc. On a phone: a 640px disc with three names shown, and the top row reduced to the wordmark and the action.
phone: 640px disc with three names; top row wordmark and action.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the rotated tagline (a sentence in the navigation) is gone; the dial is one filled disc holding one- or two-word names, with no rings or tick marks, so it is a control surface and not a drawn illustration. Un-banned.

name: HUD with a live readout
description: A fixed layer above a pinned or non-scrolling stage, never over scrolling content. Top left the wordmark and, only if the page has audio, a Sound toggle; top right a live readout of two short lines at 15px in the text face with tabular figures (for example the studio's local time and whether it is open), refreshing every 30 seconds; top centre a selector of three one-word links in the accent that appears only on the last scene of the stage and fades in over 300ms, so the ending shows the way out. Items sit 32px from the top and the margins, on the ground colour or one ink that reads on the stage. Nothing moves otherwise. On a phone: wordmark left and the readout reduced to one line at the right; the selector becomes a Menu button on the last scene.
phone: Wordmark left, one-line readout right; the selector is a Menu button on the last scene.
houseRuleCheck: Clean with conditions: only real data the page has (a live time or status), never invented numbers or fake dashboards; proportional text face, no mono, 15px minimum; used only over a stage that does not scroll.

name: In-flow header hands over to a corner pill
description: Two navigations in sequence. At load an in-flow header 88px tall sits inside the first screen and scrolls away with it: the wordmark at the left margin (h3 step), three or four one-word links at 16px starting at grid column 5, the one action as an accent pill at the right margin. Once the hero has scrolled out (past 100svh minus 88px) a compact ink pill, 52px tall and about 168px wide, fades in and drops 12px into place, fixed at the top-right corner 20px from the edges: the word Menu in ground-coloured letters beside a small square toggle that opens a full-screen sheet on the ink. The action follows as a second accent pill beside it; the monogram may stay at the top left on a solid tab. Nothing hangs over content between the two states. On a phone the in-flow header is the wordmark and Menu; after the hero the same pill appears at the top right.
phone: In-flow wordmark and Menu; after the hero the ink Menu pill and the action pill appear top right.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The pill is opaque ink with a text label (no icon-only trigger); the in-flow bar scrolls away so no fixed transparent layer runs over content.

name: Left rail of stacked tiles
description: A fixed rail 120px wide inset 20px from the left edge and from the top and bottom, holding stacked solid tiles with no gaps beyond 8px: a wordmark tile (the name on two lines at the h4 step) at the top, four link tiles 96px tall each with a one-word link at 16px in the ground, surface and ink tones, one accent action tile 120px tall, and a bottom tile in the ink with a Contact word. Only ground, surface, ink and accent tones appear. The page wrapper takes the rail's width plus 24px as padding on both sides (about 146px each at 1440) so margins stay equal and the rail sits in the left margin. Hover: a tile's fill swaps to the accent (180ms). On a phone: the rail becomes a 56px top bar with the wordmark, the action pill and a Menu text button; the tiles stack in the sheet.
phone: 56px top bar with wordmark, the action and Menu; tiles stack in the sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Tiles use the ground, surface, ink and accent tones only (no colour sprawl); the rail is inset from the edge and the content keeps equal margins on both sides; one Contact tile stands in for separate language and social tiles.

name: Links first, logo and actions arrive
description: A bar about 96px tall that is almost empty at rest. At the top of the page only four one-word links sit in the centre, 16px in the text face at weight 500, 48px apart; the hero's headline is the name, so the bar has no wordmark and no button yet. After the first 80 to 120px of scroll the bar completes itself and settles to 64px: a 36px monogram chip (ink fill, ground letter) fades in at the left margin, and at the right the one action as a filled accent pill 44px tall with a two-word label rises 8px into place over 240ms ease-out, with a two-letter language switch in plain text before it only if the page really has two languages, staggered by 60ms. While it sits over the hero the bar has no fill; as it completes it takes a solid band of the page ground and stays fixed so, so content never runs under bare letters. Ink: chosen to read on the hero, then the page ink on the band. Accent: the action pill only. On a phone: a 56px band from the start with the monogram at the left and a Menu text button and the action at the right; the four links wait in the full-screen sheet.
phone: 56px band from the start: monogram left, Menu text button and the action right; the links in the full-screen sheet.
avoidWith: heroes whose headline is not the name
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The bar has no fill only while it sits over the hero and settles onto a solid band of the ground as it completes, so no bare letters run over content. Links are words, no numbers; the action is filled, not outlined; the language switch is plain text and only for a page with two languages.

name: Live section name in the centre slot
description: A fixed solid band 56px tall in the page ground (the ink on a dark page). The wordmark at the left margin (h4 step); at the right margin a Menu text button beside the one action (a filled pill 40px tall); dead centre the live section name: one or two words at 17px in sentence case, in the ink and the same words as that section's heading or nav link, never a sentence. When a new section takes the screen the old name slides up out of a 24px mask while the new one slides up in (280ms, ease-out), so the centre reads as a quiet marker of where you are, without numbers. Over the hero the band is transparent and the centre slot is empty; the band fills solid after the hero. Hover: the Menu text takes the accent (160ms). Needs four or more named sections. On a phone the live name is dropped: wordmark left, Menu and the action right in a 56px band.
phone: 56px band: wordmark left, Menu and the action right; the live name is dropped.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the one-line serif caption (a sentence in the bar) is now the one- or two-word name of the section in view, no numbers; the white band is a solid band. Un-banned.

name: Text row with status words
description: A slim three-part text row on a solid 48px band of the page ground, fixed at the top, on 56px side margins. Type: 14px/18px in the text face at weight 500, sentence case, no letter-spacing. Left: the wordmark (display face, the same 14px, weight 700) and 24px after it a status of one to three words (a place, or a state such as open this week). Centre: a second status of one to three words, centred on the page. Right: four one-word links 28px apart and after them the one action in the accent at weight 600; the link of the section in view takes the accent with a 6px solid dot before it. Hover: the link shifts to the accent over 160ms. The band is the page ground at every scroll position, so over a hero of the same ground it is invisible and over a picture it is a slim header strip; content never runs under bare letters. On a phone: a 52px band with the wordmark at the left and a Menu text button and the action at the right; the sheet opens on the page ground with the links stacked at 36 to 48px in the display face and the two statuses beneath.
phone: 52px band: wordmark left, Menu text button and the action right; the links and statuses in the full-screen sheet.
avoidWith: heroes with a text row of their own at the top edge
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The row sits on a solid band, so nothing bare runs over pictures; type stays 14px or more, sentence case, in the text face (no monospace, no tiny tracked uppercase); each status is a few words, never a sentence; links capped at four plus the action; the current-link marker is a CSS dot, not a drawn shape.

name: Name-roll bar with live clock
description: A bar about 84px tall that belongs to the first screen and scrolls away with it. Left: a short form of the name in the display face at 24px; on the first wheel step or the first 40px of scroll it rolls up 12px inside a masked line and the full name replaces it, widening from about 110px to about 190px. Centre: a small mark set in a contrasting cut (an italic of the display face, 26px) and two one-word links 32px apart at 15px weight 500, the second of them the one action in the accent at weight 600. Right: the local time as plain text beside a place word, 15px in tabular figures of the text face, then a Menu pill 44px tall filled in the ink with ground-coloured letters, which opens a full-screen sheet. Over the hero the bar has no fill and one ink chosen for the hero. Once the hero has gone the name stays fixed at the top-left margin on a solid tab of the ground and the Menu pill at the top-right margin with the action as an accent pill beside it, so the way back stays in reach. On a phone: the short name at the left and the Menu pill and the action at the right; the mark, links and clock move into the sheet.
phone: Short name left, Menu pill and the action right; mark, links and clock in the full-screen sheet; name and pills stay fixed on solid tabs after the hero.
avoidWith: bars that already carry a live readout
heroes with a second wordmark at the top
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The clock is a time readout, not a counter, in tabular figures of the text face, never monospace; the round outline control becomes a filled Menu pill; the name roll is plain type; after the hero only solid tabs and pills stay fixed.

name: Pill controls shrinking to icon circles
description: A fixed control layer with no bar, for a hero whose headline is the name. At the top of the first screen two filled pills 52px tall with 15px weight 600 labels sit at the left margin and at the centre: the one action in the accent and one secondary word (Watch, Visit) in the surface tone; a Menu pill 52px tall in the ink sits at the right margin; the space between them stays empty. After the first 100px of scroll the two pills shrink over 300ms into 44px circles holding a standard arrow and play glyph and fade out upward, the wordmark fades in at the top-left margin on a solid tab of the ground, and the Menu pill stays. A bottom row is fixed 20px above the bottom edge on the same margins: the action as an accent pill at the left and, only if the page has audio, a Sound pill in the surface tone at the right; every fixed item is a solid pill, never bare letters, and the page keeps 96px free under its last line. On a phone: the Menu pill at the top right and the bottom row holding the action pill alone from the start; the wordmark tab fades in at the top left after the first scroll.
phone: Menu pill top right; the bottom row holds the action pill from the start; the wordmark tab fades in top left after the first scroll.
avoidWith: pages with a cookie or chat widget at the bottom edge
heroes whose headline is not the name
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The tagline between the pills and the key hint are gone, so the centre stays empty and nothing reads as a sentence; the burger circle is a Menu pill with a word; the circles hold standard glyphs, no emoji; every fixed item is a solid pill, never bare text over content.

name: Right rail with rotated labels
description: A fixed rail 64px wide running the full height of the right edge, never changing, filled with the surface tone. From the top: a 64px square Menu tile (ink fill, the word Menu at 15px in the ground colour), the wordmark rotated 90 degrees in the display face at 22px, three one- or two-word links rotated 90 degrees at 15px weight 500 in sentence case, a two-letter language toggle rotated (only on a page with two languages), and at the bottom a 64 by 120px action tile filled with the accent, its two-word label rotated. Tiles are told apart by fill steps (the surface tone, the ink, the accent), never by rules. The content's right margin is measured from the rail's inner edge and equals the left margin, and full-bleed sections stop at the rail, so nothing runs under it. Hover: a link's letters take the accent (160ms). On a phone: the rail becomes a 56px top bar with the Menu tile at the left, the wordmark, and the action tile at the right, all horizontal; the language toggle moves into the sheet.
phone: 56px top bar: Menu tile, wordmark, action tile, all horizontal; the language toggle in the sheet.
avoidWith: any second fixed bar or side rail
heroes that run edge to edge under the right side
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Tiles are separated by fills and the rotated text stays 15px or more in sentence case (no tiny tracked uppercase); the rail is one tone so it is not a stack of outlined boxes; content keeps equal margins measured from the rail.

name: Grid-aligned row of equal cells
description: A fixed row 56px tall on a solid band of the page ground, set on the page's own column grid: across the 1360px content width at 1440, six equal cells of 210px with 20px gutters, each holding one item left-aligned at its column start, 15px in the text face at weight 500. Cell one holds the wordmark (the mark alone when the hero's headline is the name), cells two to five one-word links, cell six the one action in the accent at weight 600. There is no rule or line anywhere: the cells are the grid and the gutters separate them. The section in view is marked by a solid 8px accent dot before its label; on hover the label shifts 6px right and takes the accent over 180ms. The sections below use the same six-column grid, so the row reads as their column head. On a phone: a 56px band with the wordmark at the left and a Menu text button and the action at the right; the four links return as a 2 by 2 grid of large words inside the full-screen sheet.
phone: 56px band: wordmark left, Menu text button and the action right; the links as a 2 by 2 grid of large words in the sheet.
avoidWith: pages whose sections do not share a column grid
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No rule under the cells: separation comes from the column grid and gutters, and hover moves and recolours the label (no underline, no outline). The row is on a solid band, so pictures never pass under bare letters. Type stays 15px, sentence case, text face.

name: Scene-coloured solid bar, hides
description: A fixed solid bar 56px tall: the wordmark at the left margin (display face, 20px); at the right one one-word link at 15px weight 500, a Sound word only if the page has audio, and the one action as a pill 40px tall in the ink with ground-coloured letters (on an ink scene, the ground with ink letters). The bar's fill changes with each scene, easing over 320ms, through the dealt palette's own tones only (the ground, the surface tone, the accent and the ink, never a hue of its own), and the letters flip to whichever of the ink or the ground reads best. On scroll down the bar slides off the top (translateY -100%, 500ms ease-out); on any scroll up it returns over 400ms in the colour of the scene in view. On a phone: the same bar at 52px with the wordmark at the left and a Menu text button and the action at the right; the link waits in the full-screen sheet.
phone: 52px bar in the scene's colour: wordmark left, Menu text button and the action right; hides and returns the same way.
avoidWith: pages with one ground colour throughout
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No colour sprawl: the bar only takes the palette's ground, surface, accent and ink; the sound toggle is a word, not an emoji or drawn icon; the action keeps a filled pill.

name: Scroll-assembled full-screen tile mosaic
description: The first screen carries only the wordmark at the top-left margin and a Menu text button at the top-right margin, each on a solid tab of the ground. Past the hero, nine loose tiles drift in from scattered offsets (up to 200px away, up to 4 degrees of tilt) over about 120vh of scroll and lock into a pinned full-screen 3 by 3 mosaic with 8px gaps inside the page margins (each tile about 448 by 280 at 1440 by 900): one tile holds the wordmark, one the one action in the accent, and the other seven link to the page's sections, with Contact and the email filling any left over. Each tile is a flat fill from the page's own tones only (ground, surface, ink and accent, never a new hue), placed so no two neighbours match; its label sits bottom-left, 24px in, in the display face at 28 to 40px, sentence case. Hover: the tile's fill steps to the accent and its label shifts 8px right. After assembling, the mosaic is the page's index scene and releases; from then on the Menu tab reopens the same mosaic as a full-screen sheet. On a phone: two columns by five rows inside 16px margins, the wordmark tile spanning both columns of the top row, each row one fifth of the screen height; the tiles fade in without drift.
phone: First screen: wordmark and Menu tabs. The mosaic is two columns by five rows inside 16px margins, the wordmark tile spanning the top row; tiles fade in without drift.
avoidWith: tile or card grids in the sections right after it
houseRuleCheck: Clean with care. A mosaic is a set of boxes, so it stays this one screen and the sections around it stay open and varied (no page only of boxes); tiles are solid fills with words only: no outlines, no icons, no boxes on photographs, no tile in a tile; fills come from the page's four tones, so no colour sprawl; the first screen keeps a real wordmark and Menu.

name: Segmented cell row returns as full bar
description: At the top, a centred floating row 20px below the top edge: cells 48px tall, each filled with the surface tone and separated by 4px gaps through which the page shows. In order: a wordmark cell (120px wide), four link cells (about 120px each, one-word labels centred at 15px weight 500) and an accent-filled action cell (140px); the row's outer corners at radius 14px, the inner corners 4px. Right of the row, only if the page has motion or sound, sits a 48px solid round Pause control in the ink. On scroll down the whole row slides up out of view (translateY -140%, 400ms). On any scroll up a different object returns: a full-width bar 64px tall in the same surface tone with the wordmark at the left margin, the four links centred and the action cell at the right margin, no shadow; where the section underneath is also on the surface tone the bar takes one step darker so its edge reads. On a phone: a centred row of three cells (wordmark, Menu, action) 12px below the top edge, returning the same way as a full-width 56px bar.
phone: Centred row of three cells (wordmark, Menu, action); it hides on scroll down and returns as a full-width 56px bar.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The returning bar separates by a fill step, not a shadow; the seams are gaps between filled cells, not rules or outlines; links capped at four plus the action.

name: Row of separate filled chips
description: No bar fill. A fixed row of individually filled chips in the ink, 48px tall, 8px apart, running from the left page margin: first a square chip holding the monogram, then four link chips (padding 0 20px, the dealt corner, one-word labels at 15px weight 500 in the ground colour), and one chip alone at the right margin carrying the one action in the accent. The page shows through the gaps between chips, so the row reads as loose pieces over whatever scene is below; every letter stands on a chip, never on the page. The chip of the section in view takes the surface tone with ink letters; hover moves a chip to the accent over 160ms. On a phone: the monogram chip at the left and a Menu chip and the action chip at the right, 44px tall; the links wait in the full-screen sheet.
phone: Monogram chip left, Menu chip and the action chip right; the links in the full-screen sheet.
avoidWith: pages that are mostly boxes elsewhere
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Chips are navigation, not content cards, but a row of chips over boxed sections can tip a page toward all boxes, so the sections beneath stay open. Solid fills only, no outline, no blur, no shadow; links capped at four plus the action.

name: Solid left-cluster bar, hides, returns with action
description: A fixed bar 96px tall on a solid band of the page ground, 48px side padding. Left: a lockup (a 32px mark plus the wordmark in the display face at 24px), then 40px later four one-word links at 16px weight 500, 32px apart. Right: at rest the one action as a quiet text link at weight 600. On scroll down beyond 8px the bar slides fully out (translateY -100%, 360ms ease-out). On any scroll up it returns over the same time at 72px with the action grown into a highlighted two-part group in the right slot: an accent-filled pill 52px tall holding a two-word label and, beside it, a round part with an arrow glyph, the two separated by a 4px gap, not by a line. Ink: the page ink. Accent: the returning action group only. On a phone: a 64px bar with the wordmark at the left and a Menu text button at the right, the same hide and return, the action group appearing beside Menu on return.
phone: 64px bar: wordmark left, Menu text button right; hides on scroll down and returns with the action group beside Menu.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Solid fill, no rule, no shadow; the action group is filled, not outlined, and split from its arrow part by a gap, not a line.

name: Minimal solid bar with control swap
description: A fixed bar 72px tall on a solid band of the page ground holding only three things: the lockup at the left margin (a 28px mark plus the wordmark), and at the right margin a Menu text button with one quiet slot before it: the language as a text dropdown (the current language at 15px with a small caret glyph) on a page with two languages, otherwise a Sign in or Visit text link. Once the hero has scrolled away (past the hero height minus 72px) that slot swaps in place for the one action as a filled button (44px tall, radius 12px, a two-word label at 15px weight 600, accent fill), cross-fading over 150ms; at the same moment the bar's fill steps to a tint (the ink at 5% over the ground, as a solid colour) so it separates from the sections below without a line. Menu opens the links in a full-screen sheet on the ink with the action and the email. On a phone: the lockup and Menu from the start; the action button appears beside Menu after the hero.
phone: Lockup and Menu text button; the action button appears beside Menu right after the hero.
avoidWith: bars with a full link set
pages with no distinct hero to scroll past
houseRuleCheck: Clean. A line under the bar is replaced by a fill step; the button is filled, never outlined; the Menu button keeps the links in reach since the bar shows none.

name: Solid sticky bar, left cluster plus utilities
description: A sticky bar 72px tall that never hides, the same scrolling up or down, on a solid band of the page ground. Left: the lockup, then three primary links at 16px weight 500, 28px apart. Right: a search glyph (only if the site has search), two utility links (Sign in, Help) at 15px weight 400 in the muted ink (a solid mid tone, not transparency), and the one action as a filled accent button 44px tall. Two weights and two inks give a primary and a secondary level without any divider. The bar separates from the content by a fill step (the first section sits on another tone, or the bar takes a faint solid tint of the ink), never a rule or a shadow. On a phone: the lockup at the left and the action and a Menu text button at the right; search and the utility links move into the sheet.
phone: Lockup left, the action and a Menu text button right; search and the utility links in the sheet.
avoidWith: announcement or utility strips above it
houseRuleCheck: Clean. A rule under the bar is replaced by a fill step; no shadow; links capped at three primary and two utility.

name: Solid bar with flush action block, hides
description: A sticky bar 72px tall on a solid band of the page ground. Left: the lockup at the page margin. Centre: five one-word links at 16px weight 500, 28px apart. Right, flush to the screen edge and running the full height of the bar: a cell 88px wide in a solid tint (the ink at 6% over the ground) holding a two-letter language label on a page with two languages, or Sign in otherwise, then a 216px action block filled in the ink (or the accent) with a 16px weight 600 label in the ground colour. No rule anywhere: the cells are separated by their fills. The bar slides out on scroll down (translateY -100%, 360ms) and returns on any scroll up. On a phone: the lockup at the left, a Menu text button, and a 120px action block flush to the right edge, with the same hide and return.
phone: Lockup left, Menu text button, then a 120px action block flush to the right edge; same hide and return.
avoidWith: a second fixed element at the right edge
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Rules under the bar and beside the language cell are replaced by fills; the cells are filled blocks, not outlined boxes; the action block meets the screen edge as part of a full-width bar, not as content running into the edge.

name: Split bar takes each scene's ground
description: A fixed bar 60px tall in three parts: three one-word links at the left margin (15px weight 500, 24px apart), a 32px monogram centred, and at the right margin one text link and the one action as a pill 36px tall in the accent; on a shop a basket glyph button joins them. Over the hero the bar has no fill; as the following scenes arrive it fills with each scene's ground over 320ms and the monogram and links flip to the ink that reads on it; the grounds come from the page's own tones (ground, surface, ink, accent), never a new hue. A second element persists: a fixed bottom row 20px above the bottom edge on the page margins with small solid tabs of the ground holding 14px words: Top, and Sound only if the page has audio. On a phone: the monogram centred, a Menu text button at the left and the action pill at the right; the bottom row keeps Top.
phone: Monogram centred, Menu text button left, the action pill right; the bottom row keeps Top.
avoidWith: other fixed bottom rows or docks
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Scene grounds come from the page palette only (no colour sprawl); the bottom controls are words on solid tabs, not a progress bar or counter and not bare letters over content; links capped at four plus the action.

name: Pair of floating panels
description: Two panels float 17px below the top edge, together spanning the page margins. A wide panel (about 1010px at 1440) 56px tall, radius 16px, in the surface tone: the lockup at its left, five one-word links centred at 15px weight 500. A narrow panel about 190px by 56px beside it is the one action, filled in the accent (or the ink) with a 15px weight 600 label. They sit 19px apart; on a shop or a site with search a 56px solid round glyph button (bag or search) in the ink stands centred in a wider gap between them. Both stay fixed and opaque at every scroll position; where a scene's ground is as light as the panels, they flip to the ink with ground-coloured letters (200ms). On a phone: one panel the width less 16px margins, 52px tall, holding the lockup, a Menu text button and a small action pill.
phone: One panel the width less 16px margins: lockup, Menu text button, small action pill.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The panels are navigation, not cards, opaque with no shadow at rest and no outline; the glyph button appears only where the site has search or a basket.

name: Logo split across the width
description: No bar. The wordmark is cut into three pieces set at one height, 28px from the top of the first screen: the first at the left margin, the second centred on the page, the third ending at the right margin. Each piece is a syllable or short word of three to five letters in the display face at 28 to 36px, weight 600, so the three read together left to right as the name. Beneath the right piece, right-aligned, a row of three one-word links at 15px weight 500, 20px apart, and the one action in the accent at weight 600. The pieces and links belong to the first screen and scroll away with it; their ink is chosen to read on the hero. After the hero a 56px solid band of the ground returns on any scroll up with the whole wordmark at the left and a Menu text button and the action at the right. Dealt only where the hero's headline is not the name and the name splits cleanly into three short pieces. On a phone: one 56px row with the whole wordmark at the left and Menu and the action at the right; the split is a desktop device.
phone: One 56px row: the whole wordmark left, Menu text button and the action right; the split stays on desktop.
avoidWith: heroes that set the name again in giant type
names that do not break into three short pieces
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Type only, no drawn shapes; the name is cut by letters, never by an illustration; the pieces scroll away with the hero so no bare letters run over content, and a solid band brings the navigation back.

name: Bar with centre toggle on a flooding ground
description: A fixed bar 88px tall on a page whose ground is one fixed layer that floods to the colour of the cover section in view over 400ms; the bar is filled with that same ground and changes with it, so it is opaque yet reads as part of the page. Left: the wordmark in the display face at 32px. Centre: a two-option text toggle, a 240px by 52px track filled with a tint of the ink and a sliding filled pill under the active word (ink fill, ground-coloured letters, 17px weight 500); the two words switch between two audiences, collections or modes of the content (240ms slide). Right: a Menu text button and the one action as an accent pill 44px tall. The grounds come from the dealt palette only (three or four tones at most) and the letters flip to the contrast ink with each ground. On a phone: a 64px bar with the wordmark at the left and Menu and the action at the right; the toggle moves to the top of the full-screen sheet.
phone: 64px bar: wordmark left, Menu text button and the action right; the toggle at the top of the full-screen sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The 180px fill-less bar is cut to 88px (navigation takes a tenth of the first screen at most) and filled with the flooding ground, so content never runs under bare letters; the covers' grounds come from the dealt palette, three or four at most; the toggle track is a filled tint, not an outline.

name: Tall wordmark bar that collapses
description: A fixed bar that starts tall and collapses on scroll. At rest it is 120px high with no fill over the hero: a large typographic wordmark at the left (about 212px wide, the display face at 56px in a heavy weight, type only), four one-word links at 16px weight 600, 32px apart, and at the right margin the one action as an accent pill 48px tall (on a shop the basket as a word before it). Over the first 120px of scroll the bar eases to 70px and takes a solid band of the page ground; the wordmark scales and cross-fades (200ms) into a 40px monogram chip, and the four links fold into a Menu pill 44px tall in the ink beside the action, so content never runs under bare letters. On a phone: a 72px bar with the wordmark about 150px wide, a Menu text button and the action, collapsing to 56px with the monogram the same way.
phone: 72px bar: wordmark about 150px wide, Menu text button and the action; collapses to 56px with the monogram.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No announcement line above the bar; the illustrated mascot becomes a type-only wordmark (no drawn illustration); outlined icon buttons become a filled Menu pill; the collapsed bar is opaque.

name: Tall spread header that scrolls away
description: A tall header, 120px, that belongs to the first screen and scrolls away with it (absolutely positioned over the hero, not fixed), with 40px padding at the sides and top. Left: a large wordmark about 200px wide (display face about 56px in a heavy weight) followed 40px later by one one-word link; centre: two one-word links 32px apart; right: the one action as a text link at weight 600 in the accent at the right margin; all links 16px weight 500, so the three slots spread across the whole width. Over the hero its ink is one colour chosen for the hero. Nothing replaces it on a page of up to ten screens; on a longer page the one action returns after the hero as an accent pill fixed at the top-right margin, so the way to act stays in reach. Dealt only where the hero's headline is not the name. On a phone: a 64px row with the wordmark (about 140px) at the left and Menu and the action at the right; the links in the full-screen sheet.
phone: 64px row: wordmark left, Menu text button and the action right; the links in the full-screen sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Height cut from about 163px to 120px so the header stays small furniture; the big wordmark is the header's, never a giant footer name, and the hero below still fills the first screen alone; on a long page the action stays in reach.

name: Text-only three-part row
description: A pure-text row 56px tall with no buttons, chips or icons. The wordmark at grid column 1 (h4 step); a run of three or four one-word links starting at grid column 7 (x about 720 at 1440) at 16px with 32px between them; the one action as a plain text link at the right margin in the accent at weight 600. The row sits on a solid band of the page ground and is fixed; over a hero of the same ground the band is invisible, over any other it is a plain header band. The link of the section in view takes weight 600 (never an underline). Content scrolls under the band, never under bare letters. Hover: the link ink steps to the accent (160ms). On a phone: the wordmark at the left and a Menu text button at the right; the links wait in the full-screen sheet with the action at the foot.
phone: Wordmark left, Menu text button right; links and action in the full-screen sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The row sits on a solid band, so content never slides under bare letters; the current link is marked by weight, not an underline (no thin rules).

name: Menu, centred mark, scene word column
description: A loose fixed layer for a page whose scenes hold the screen one at a time (full-screen or pinned scenes). Top left: a Menu text button (16px weight 600, switching to Close) that opens a full-screen sheet. Top centre: the monogram as a 40px mark. Top right: the one action as a filled accent pill 44px tall. At the right margin, vertically centred: a column of five to eight scene names in the text face at 15px on a 28px line pitch, right-aligned, sentence case; the current scene in full ink, the others in the muted ink; hover brings a name to full ink over 160ms and a click goes to that scene. Every item stands on a small solid tab of the ground (8-12px padding, the dealt corner), so no letters run over moving pictures. On a phone: Menu, the monogram and the action stay at the top; the column is replaced by two 44px solid round previous and next arrows at the bottom centre.
phone: Menu, monogram and the action at the top; two 44px solid round previous and next arrows at the bottom centre replace the column.
avoidWith: other scroll indicators or progress devices
pages with fewer than four distinct scenes
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The dot rail is a position indicator close to a scroll-progress device, so it becomes a column of scene words (no dots, no track, no numbers); names one or two words; every fixed item on a solid tab; the action is in the layer.

name: Transparent bar, centre monogram, scale settle
description: A fixed bar that settles from 84px to 64px over the first 720px of scroll. Left: the lockup (the wordmark in the display face with a small mark). Centre: a monogram of one or two letters in the display face at 44px. Right: a Menu text button at 16px weight 600 and the one action as a filled accent button 48px tall with a two-word label at 15px weight 600. The lockup and the button start at scale 1.2 and ease to 1 across those 720px, scroll-linked, with transform origins at the left and right edges. Over the hero the bar has no fill and its ink is chosen to read on it; by the time the hero has gone it has taken a solid band of the page ground with ink letters, and it stays fixed so. On a phone: a 60px band with the lockup at scale 1 at the left, the monogram centred at 36px and Menu at the right; the action sits in the hero and at the sheet's foot.
phone: 60px band: lockup left, monogram centred at 36px, Menu right; the action in the hero and the sheet.
avoidWith: bars that carry another centre mark
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The monogram is set in type (the first letter in the display face where the brand has no mark); the icon button becomes a Menu text button; the bar takes a solid band before content can pass under it.

name: Open bar, wordmark left, links right
description: A two-slot bar 88px tall on the page margins. The wordmark stands at the left margin at the h3 step; at the right margin one to three one-word links at 16px, 36px apart, the last of them the one action as a filled pill 44px tall in the accent with ground-coloured letters. The whole middle stays empty. Over the hero the bar has no fill and sits on the hero's own ground, its ink chosen to read on it. Once the hero has gone (scroll past 100svh minus 88px) it settles into a 60px solid band of the page ground by transform and background-colour alone (260ms), the ink following the ground, and stays fixed. Link hover: the letters roll up out of a 24px mask and the same word rolls in from below (220ms). On a phone: a 60px bar with the wordmark left, a Menu text button and the action pill at the right; the links wait in the full-screen sheet.
phone: 60px bar: wordmark left, Menu text button and the action pill right; links in the full-screen sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The action is a filled pill, not outlined; a fixed bar never floats transparent over content, so it takes an opaque band after the hero; links are one word, 16px, sentence case.

name: Transparent bar, phone bottom dock
description: On desktop a fixed bar 72px tall: the wordmark and three one-word links at the left (15px weight 500, 28px apart), the monogram as a 48px solid round chip centred (ink fill, ground letter) that returns to the top, and at the right one text link and the one action as a filled accent pill 44px tall. Over the hero it has no fill; once the hero has gone it is a solid band of the page ground. On a phone the whole navigation moves to the bottom as a floating pill 300px by 62px (width min(300px, 100% minus 40px)), docked 22px above the bottom edge plus the safe area and centred, opaque in the ink with radius 31px: a Menu text button at the left, the monogram centred and the action as a one-word accent pill at the right. At the top of the phone screen only the wordmark stands, scrolling away with the hero. No blur, no shadow at rest; the page keeps 100px free under its last line.
phone: A 300 by 62 opaque pill in the ink docked 22px above the bottom: Menu text button, monogram, the action as a one-word accent pill; the wordmark at the top scrolls away with the hero.
avoidWith: other fixed elements at the bottom edge
cookie or chat widgets at the bottom
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The phone pill is a solid fill, never blurred glass, with no shadow at rest; the desktop bar is opaque once content passes under it; the toggle and icon buttons give way to a text link and the monogram.

name: Transparent bar with pill-link group
description: A bar 86px tall with no fill of its own. Left: the wordmark (display face 24px) and, 24px after it, a search glyph only if the site has search; no divider. Right: a group of three link pills and the action pill (40px tall, padding 0 20px, fully round, 8px apart): the three links filled in the surface tone with ink 15px weight 500 labels, the action filled in the accent with ground-coloured letters; on a page with two languages a two-letter language word follows 24px after the group. The wordmark, search and language word belong to the first screen and scroll away with it; the pill group alone stays fixed at the top-right margin, 22px below the edge, and since every pill is a solid fill nothing bare runs over content. Over sections on the ink the link pills turn to a tone one step lighter than the ink with ground-coloured letters (200ms). On a phone: the wordmark at the left and a Menu pill and the action pill at the right; the link pills appear large and stacked in the full-screen sheet.
phone: Wordmark left, Menu pill and the action pill right; the pills stacked large in the full-screen sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No divider beside the wordmark; pills are filled, never outlined; the recolour uses the palette's own tones; only the solid pills stay fixed, so no bare letters run over content; three links plus the action.

name: Transparent bar returns as compact pill
description: At the top a bar 84px tall that belongs to the first screen and has no fill over the hero: a wide lockup at the left (about 180px) and at the right four one-word links at 16px weight 500, 28px apart, the last of them the one action as an accent pill 44px tall. On scroll down it leaves. On any scroll up it returns as a different object: a compact pill about 480px by 44px, centred 22px below the top edge, solid in the ink (opaque, no blur), fully round, holding a 28px monogram in place of the wordmark, the three links at 14px weight 500 in the ground colour 18px apart, and the action as an accent pill inset at its right end. The swap runs 240ms with the pill dropping 12px into place. Hover: link letters take the accent. On a phone: the wordmark and a Menu text button and the action at the top; on scroll up the pill returns as a 44px bar the width less 32px with the monogram, Menu and the action.
phone: Wordmark, Menu text button and the action at the top; on scroll up a 44px ink pill the width less 32px with the monogram, Menu and the action.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The dark glass pill is an opaque solid pill (no backdrop blur, no translucency); no shadow at rest; links capped at three plus the action.

name: Transparent row returns as white panel
description: At the top a row 82px tall with no fill, inset 148px from each side (1144px wide at 1440), for a hero whose headline is the name, so the row carries no wordmark: four one-word links at the left (16px weight 500, 28px apart); at the right one text link with a small one-word badge beside it (24px tall, accent fill, fully round, such as New) and the one action as a filled button 44px tall. As the page scrolls the row fades out within about 720px. On the first scroll up it returns as a panel of the same width, 64px tall, radius 20px, filled solid in the surface tone, fading in and dropping 8px over 240ms; the panel now carries the wordmark at its left before the links. Where the section under it is also on the surface tone the panel takes one step darker so its edge reads. Ink: chosen for the hero at the top, the page ink on the panel. On a phone: a panel the width less 32px with the wordmark, a Menu text button and the action, returning the same way.
phone: Panel the width less 32px: wordmark, Menu text button and the action; hides and returns the same way.
avoidWith: heroes whose headline is not the name
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The panel has no shadow at rest and no outline; the badge is one word with no gradient; the three-dot glyph is dropped; the returning panel brings the wordmark since the hero is gone.

name: Split bar, centred wordmark, flat ground
description: A symmetrical split bar 80px tall. The wordmark sits dead centre at the h3 step with 96px of clear air on each side; two or three one-word links at 16px stand at the left margin, one link and the one action (a filled pill 44px tall in the accent) at the right margin, 36px between items, each group ending 96px from the wordmark. The bar is filled with the page ground from the first pixel and its letters are in the ink, so over a flat-ground hero it reads as part of the page and over any other hero it is a solid header band with the picture starting below it; either way no content runs under it. It stays fixed and never changes height or colour. Hover: the letters lift 3px and take the accent (160ms). On a phone: a 60px bar with the wordmark centred, Menu at the left and the action at the right; the links wait in the full-screen sheet.
phone: 60px bar: wordmark centred, Menu left, the action right; links in the full-screen sheet.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The bar is opaque from the first pixel, so content never runs under bare letters; links are one word; the wordmark is not repeated when the hero headline is the name (the mark alone then).

name: Transparent split bar, menu left, hides
description: A fixed bar 76px tall in three parts. Left: a Menu text button (16px weight 600) and, 28px after it, one one-word link. Centre: a wide wordmark about 200px in the display face at 28px. Right: a two-letter language switch in plain text (only on a page with two languages) and the one action as a filled accent button 44px tall. Over the hero the bar has no fill and its ink is chosen to read on it. It slides out on scroll down (translateY -100%, 360ms) and returns on scroll up on a solid band of the page ground. Menu opens a full-screen sheet with the links, the action and the email. On a phone: Menu at the left, the wordmark centred at about 140px, the action at the right; the language switch in the sheet.
phone: Menu left, wordmark centred at about 140px, the action right; hides and returns on a solid band.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The returning bar is a solid band of the ground, never transparent over content; filled button, plain text switch, no rule, no shadow.

name: Three-part bar, ink band after the hero
description: A three-part bar 88px tall. The wordmark at the left margin (h3 step); four or five one-word links centred on the page's centre line at 16px with 40px between them; at the right margin one text link and the one action as a filled pill 44px tall in the accent. Over the hero the bar has no fill and its ink is chosen to read on the hero. After the hero it becomes a 64px band that flips to the ink colour, with wordmark and links in the ground colour and the action turned into a ground-coloured button with ink letters, by background-colour and transform (280ms, never through grey), and it stays fixed. Link hover: the other links dim to 55% opacity while one is hovered. On a phone: 60px, wordmark left and a Menu text button right; Menu opens a full-screen sheet on the ink with the links at the h2 step stacked on the left and the action at the foot.
phone: 60px: wordmark left, Menu right; full-screen sheet on the ink with large links and the action.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The icon button is dropped and the outline toggle pill is a filled pill; links capped at five; the ink flip is a real change to an opaque band, never translucency.

name: Transparent wordmark, action and menu pill, hides
description: A fixed bar 86px tall with no visible links. Left: a large wordmark in the display face at 34px in a heavy weight (about 220px wide). Right: the one action as a filled accent button 48px tall with a two-word label at 15px weight 600 and, 12px beside it, a Menu pill 48px tall in a solid tint of the ink with the word Menu at 15px weight 600. Over the hero the bar has no fill. It slides fully up on scroll down (400ms ease-out) and returns on scroll up on a solid band of the page ground. phone: Same bar at 64px: wordmark at 26px, a one-word action and the Menu pill; hides and returns on a solid band.

name: Two top corners, minimal
description: No bar: one small solid tab in each top corner, 40px from the top edge and the page margin from the sides, filled with the page ground (10-14px padding, the dealt corner). Left: the wordmark at the h4 step. Right: one item only, either a Menu text button at 16px or, on a shop, the basket link, in the accent. The middle of the top edge stays empty at every scroll position; both tabs are fixed and unchanged.
